title: "Cursorless: A spoken language for editing code" by Pokey Rule (Strange Loop 2023)
summary: Pokey Rule presents Cursorless, a spoken language designed for editing code by voice, built on tree-sitter parsing with smart structural and simple token-level primitives. The talk is from Strange Loop 2023.
why: HN recommends it as the best overview of Cursorless, likened to vim with your voice, and relevant to accessibility and voice coding discussions.

quote.text: If you want a general overview of cursorless, along with seeing what it looks like in practice, the talk from Strange Loop this year was great
